g.text: Cursive (K944, as drawn): edit each letter in 'Letters - draw here' (one path per pen stroke, in pen order, dots and crosses last); the build takes it exactly as saved.

Reference only: 'Joins' = entry tick (orange, back along the arriving join), exit tick (purple), high entry ticks (cyan after o, b, v, w; pink after b, v, w where it differs); rings = junctions. 'Context' = generated joins from and to an n; yellow = a fused stretch (drawn once; the pen retraces it from the junction to the top); last row: the font's own oe, ot, oa.

Guides: ascender 244.6 u, x-height 120 u, baseline, descender -124.6 u (the font's wght-100 outline heights at x-height 120 u). Guides, Context and Joins are rebuilt on every run from your letters; edits there are not read (the build lists them).
and (generated from the bodies above; reference)
oe ot oa: the font's own (wght 100 outlines; the variants the generator makes after o; reference)
